areas.name: PC Route and Save Safety
areas.location_cue: The Steam library, title screen, account-link prompt, and local Windows save folder.
areas.note: Fresh native-PC route. Returnal is absent from games.json, and Sami confirmed PC as the chosen platform; no secondary or emulated route applies.

levels.1: Check the bundled modes before beginning the profile.
levels.2: Update the Steam release and confirm the Tower and online modes appear on the title screen.
levels.3: Install all current files, launch once online, and verify Suspend Cycle, co-op, Photo Mode, Daily Challenge access when unlocked, and the Tower entry are present; the PC package includes the expansion content.

levels.1: Protect permanent collection progress between long cleanup sessions.
levels.2: Close the game and copy %LOCALAPPDATA%\Returnal\Steam\Saved\SaveGames.
levels.3: Exit fully, let Steam Cloud finish, copy the entire SaveGames folder to a dated location outside Returnal, and keep several milestones. Restore only while the game and cloud client are closed so an older sync cannot replace the chosen copy.

levels.1: The PC account-link option adds a wardrobe choice.
levels.2: Link a PlayStation Network account from the PC version, then inspect the ship wardrobe.
levels.3: Use the account-link prompt or the title-screen account option, complete the PlayStation Network link, reload the profile if needed, and select Model 9 at the wardrobe inside the ship.

levels.1: A second PC wardrobe choice arrives through the same account link.
levels.2: After linking PlayStation Network, inspect the other unlocked suit in the ship wardrobe.
levels.3: Confirm the link remains active, return to the ship, and equip Model 14 once so both PC bonus outfits have been verified on this profile.

areas.name: Tower of Sisyphus
areas.location_cue: An elevated gate above the crash site leads to an endless sequence of compact combat rooms and a hospital hub.
areas.note: The leaderboard ascent has no terminal floor. This checklist covers every finite unlock, collectible, research entry, and conclusion while leaving score chasing open-ended.

save_backup.title: Back up before the final Tower return
save_backup.why: The finite Tower conclusion is replayable, but the required climb is long and the relevant hub state changes after completion.
save_backup.detail: Close Returnal after the six-poppy hospital visit and copy the complete SaveGames folder before repeating Phase 3, Room 20.

point_of_no_return.title: The final hospital return commits the Tower conclusion
point_of_no_return.why: Using the bed after the repeated third guardian form resolves the active Tower sequence.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish all Tower logs, tablets, and archive scans that are currently available before using the bed in this state.

levels.1: A high gate near the crash site becomes reachable with a permanent traversal tool.
levels.2: Return to the crash site after obtaining the Icarian Grapnel and use the elevated grapple route.
levels.3: Look above the ship for the Tower gate, grapple across the broken approach, scan the first entry markers, and use the elevator. Tower runs are solo and begin with their own temporary loadout.

items.label: Clear the third Tower guardian form

levels.1: Each phase ends at room twenty with a stronger version of the same combat test.
levels.2: Reach Phase 3, Room 20 and finish the encounter.
levels.3: Preserve a high-damage weapon or Disgorger for room 20, clear all three health phases, then return to the hospital hub after the run. This is the last finite guardian form required by the Tower's conclusion; later phases continue endlessly for score.

levels.1: One more elevator ride verifies the complete finite combat ladder.
levels.2: After clearing Phase 3, Room 20, use the next elevator and enter the following room.
levels.3: Finish the third guardian form without ending the run, take the elevator, and survive long enough for Phase 4 to register. Beyond this point the mode has no final floor, so further ascent is an optional score pursuit rather than an omitted ending.
